definitions: To continue for a longer time than expected or desired.
To be powered by a particular type of fuel or energy.
To continue speaking or writing without interruption or apparent end.
To have a particular number of pages or a particular length.
examples: The meeting seemed to run on forever.
Does this car run on petrol or diesel?
She tends to run on a bit when she's nervous.
The report will run on for about fifty pages.
